Title: Fresh install launches as home app
Steps: 1. Install APK. 2. Press Home. 3. Choose Lawnchair as default home app.
Expected result: Home screen renders with default layout, no crash/ANR, status bar and dock visible.

Title: Upgrade install preserves data
Preconditions: Previous release installed with custom layout, icon pack and settings
Expected result: Layout, folders, widgets, dock, icon pack and settings unchanged; legacy pref migration (SharedPreferences → DataStore) causes no ANR.

Title: Cold start time & no crash
Steps: 1. Force-stop. 2. Press Home 5 times, measuring time to first frame.
Expected result: Home appears; no crash in logcat (`FATAL EXCEPTION`/`ANR in`); startup comparable to previous build (±20%).

Title: Process death restore
Preconditions: Home screen with 2 pages, one folder open
Steps: 1. `adb shell am kill app.lawnchair*`. 2. Press Home.
Expected result: Launcher restarts to home page (or last page per 'remember position'), layout intact.

Title: Reboot persistence
Expected result: Lawnchair is home; layout, widgets, wallpaper, settings intact.

Title: Each channel installs side-by-side correctly
Expected result: All three coexist (distinct application IDs); each launches independently.

Title: Uninstall/ clear data
Expected result: Launcher rebuilds default layout with no crash.

Title: Add app shortcut by drag from drawer
Steps: 1. Long-press an app in drawer. 2. Drop on home page.
Expected result: Icon placed in the cell under finger; persists after restart.

Title: Move icon within and across pages
Steps: 1. Long-press icon. 2. Drag to other page edge. 3. Drop.
Expected result: Icon moves; page auto-scrolls; neighbours reflow per grid rules; no overlap.

Title: Remove icon / uninstall target
Steps: 1. Drag icon to Remove. 2. Drag app icon to Uninstall (cancel).
Expected result: Remove deletes shortcut only; Uninstall prompts system dialog.

Title: Add / remove / reorder pages
Steps: 1. Drag icon to right edge to create new page. 2. Empty a page.
Expected result: New page created; empty pages are removed according to AOSP rules; page indicator updates.

Title: Add widget (normal)
Steps: 1. Long-press → Widgets. 2. Drag widget to home.
Expected result: Widget placed and renders; survives restart.

Title: Add widget with configuration activity
Expected result: Config activity shown; widget placed after OK; cancel removes it cleanly.

Title: Widget resize + 'force resize' / 'unlimited size' / 'allow overlap' prefs
Preconditions: Settings → Home screen widget options toggled
Steps: 1. Enable options. 2. Resize widget beyond provider limits / overlap another.
Expected result: Behaviour follows each toggle; disabling reverts to constrained behaviour.

Title: Rounded widgets toggle
Expected result: Widget corners update (where supported) with no crash.

Title: Lock home screen
Steps: 1. Long-press icon/empty area; try to drag.
Expected result: Drag/edit blocked; popup lock button state consistent; disabling restores edit.

Title: Remember last page vs default home page
Steps: 1. Go to page 3. 2. Press Home / leave and return.
Expected result: Behaviour matches the setting.

Title: Wallpaper & depth effect
Steps: 1. Toggle wallpaper depth effect. 2. Open drawer.
Expected result: Parallax/zoom as configured; no jank/crash.

Title: Status bar & dark status bar options
Steps: 1. Toggle 'show status bar', 'dark status bar', 'status bar clock'.
Expected result: Status bar visibility/ icon colour follow settings over light and dark wallpapers.

Title: Rotation (if rotation allowed) and tablet/foldable
Expected result: Grid recomputed, no lost icons, no crash; items stay on same pages.

Title: Change home grid rows/columns
Expected result: Launcher reloads; icons are re-placed without loss; reduced grid pushes extra icons to new page rather than deleting.

Title: Icon size factor (home & drawer)
Expected result: Icons scale; no clipping beyond cell; reset returns to default.

Title: Label size & visibility (home, folder, drawer)
Steps: 1. Toggle labels off/on; change label size factors; enable two-line drawer labels.
Expected result: Label state follows settings in each context independently.

Title: Padding / margin factors (workspace, widget, drawer, hotseat bottom)
Expected result: Layout adjusts without overlap with dock/status bar; reset works.

Title: Drawer grid (columns, cell height)
Steps: 1. Change drawer columns / cell height factor.
Expected result: Drawer reflows; fast-scroller still works.

Title: Settings survive restart and backup
Expected result: Grid values restored exactly.

Title: Hotseat mode: Lawnchair (default)
Expected result: Lawnchair QSB shown in dock/above dock; apps in dock launch.

Title: Hotseat mode: Disabled
Expected result: Search bar hidden (empty view); dock icons still usable.

Title: Hotseat mode: Google Search (Google app installed)
Expected result: Google-style bar appears; tapping opens Google search.

Title: Hotseat mode: Google Search unavailable
Expected result: Option unavailable/hidden (`isAvailable=false`); stored value 'google_search' falls back sanely; no crash.

Title: Dock enable/disable and background styling
Steps: 1. Toggle `isHotseatEnabled`. 2. Change background colour/ corner radius.
Expected result: Dock hides/shows; background reflects settings; icons keep vertical spacing (regression: #7478, #7580).

Title: Paged hotseat
Expected result: Pages behave and persist.

Title: Dock label option
Expected result: Labels in dock follow setting.

Title: Create folder by dropping icon on icon
Expected result: Folder created containing both; persists.

Title: Rename folder
Expected result: Title persists after restart.

Title: Folder open/close animation & drag out
Steps: 1. Open. 2. Drag item out. 3. Remove until 1 item left.
Expected result: Item leaves; folder with 1 item collapses to single icon (AOSP behaviour); no crash.

Title: Folder style settings (colour, opacity, shape, preview)
Expected result: Closed and open folder reflect changes.

Title: Lawndeck: auto folders in drawer
Expected result: Folders created from flowerpot categories; apps listed correctly; no duplicate folders.

Title: App-drawer folder CRUD
Steps: 1. Create folder, select apps, rename, reorder, hide, delete.
Expected result: Each operation persists (Room `FolderDao/Service`); deleted folder's apps back in main list.

Title: Folder with uninstalled app
Expected result: Entry removed/ignored; no crash on opening drawer.

Title: Open drawer via swipe up and via gesture
Steps: 1. Swipe up from home. 2. Press Home to close.
Expected result: Drawer opens/closes smoothly; scrim/background per settings.

Title: Alphabetical list, fast scroller, section letters
Expected result: Letter bubble shows; list jumps correctly.

Title: Work profile tab
Steps: 1. Open drawer → Work tab. 2. Toggle work mode.
Expected result: Tab styling per settings; apps greyed/paused when work off.

Title: Hidden apps
Steps: 1. Hide an app. 2. Search for it (with and without 'show hidden apps in search').
Expected result: Not in drawer; appears in search only if `hiddenAppsInSearch`; unhide restores.

Title: Suggested/predicted apps row
Expected result: Predictions row appears/updates; disabling removes it; dismissed predictions respected.

Title: Drawer search bar visibility & keyboard auto-show
Expected result: Bar hidden/shown; keyboard shows on open when enabled.

Title: App long-press popup (shortcuts, widgets, app info, uninstall)
Expected result: Popup lists system shortcuts, Lawnchair actions; ordering follows 'launcher popup order'.

Title: Drawer icon actions: drag to home, App info
Steps: 1. Drag an app from drawer to home. 2. Long-press → App info.
Expected result: Shortcut added to home; App info screen opens; no crash.

Title: App search – prefix & substring
Expected result: Apps whose labels match listed first; clearing returns list.

Title: Fuzzy search toggle
Expected result: Fuzzy ON → finds Chrome; OFF → no match.

Title: Local algorithm: contacts, files, settings, shortcuts, history
Expected result: Each section shows with limits from `max*ResultCount` prefs; without permission the section is absent / prompts.

Title: Calculator results
Expected result: Valid expressions show correct result (8, 2.5, 9); invalid shows nothing; no crash.

Title: Web suggestions / providers (built-in, custom)
Steps: 1. Type a query. 2. Switch provider; add custom provider URL.
Expected result: Suggestions limited to `maxWebSuggestionResultCount`; tapping opens selected provider; custom URL works with `%s` replacement.

Title: ASI search availability gating
Steps: 1. Select ASI algorithm on supported and unsupported config.
Expected result: Supported → ASI used; unsupported → falls back to App search (no crash).

Title: Recent searches / history
Expected result: Recents appear; clear works.

Title: Search result limits & sections order
Expected result: Counts match prefs; no duplicate dividers (`removeDuplicateDividers`).

Title: QSB provider choice (each major provider)
Steps: 1. Pick Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Firefox, Kagi, Wikipedia, YouTube, GitHub…
Expected result: Icon renders correctly (regression #7581: YouTube icon solid circle); tapping opens provider app or website; uninstalled-app providers fall back to web.

Title: QSB style: themed, matching hotseat, corner radius
Expected result: Colours/shape update live.

Title: Default swipe-up opens drawer
Expected result: Drawer opens.

Title: Swipe-down default (notifications)
Expected result: Notification shade opens (needs accessibility handler where applicable).

Title: Assign each handler to each gesture
Steps: 1. For each of Open drawer, Open app, App search, Search, Assistant, Notifications, Quick settings, Recents, Sleep: assign & trigger.
Expected result: Handler runs; handlers needing accessibility prompt for it and degrade gracefully when not granted.

Title: Double-tap to sleep (Auto/Root/Accessibility/Device-admin)
Expected result: Screen locks/turns off under each mode; missing prerequisite shows prompt, no crash.

Title: Open specific app via gesture (+ app picker)
Steps: 1. Choose app. 2. Uninstall that app. 3. Trigger.
Expected result: App opens; after uninstall no crash (no-op or reset).

Title: Gestures disabled when home locked / in overview
Expected result: No unintended actions.

Title: Icon-level gestures
Expected result: Configured action fires.

Title: Apply icon pack
Steps: 1. Settings → Icon pack → select. 2. Return home.
Expected result: Icons from pack applied (drawer, home, folders); fallback for unthemed apps; reselect system restores.

Title: Per-app icon override (icon picker)
Steps: 1. Long-press → edit icon → pick drawable. 2. Restart.
Expected result: Override persists (Room `IconOverride`); reset removes it.

Title: Icon shape & custom shape
Steps: 1. Select each shape; create custom path.
Expected result: Shape applied to adaptive icons, folder shape separate when set; invalid path rejected.

Title: Themed icons (Material You)
Expected result: Monochrome icons tint to palette; apps without monochrome handled via fallback.

Title: Accent / colour style, dark & light mode
Steps: 1. Toggle system dark mode. 2. Change accent/colour style.
Expected result: Drawer, popups, settings, folders recolour correctly; text contrast adequate.

Title: Fonts selection & additional fonts
Expected result: Launcher text uses selected font; invalid font file rejected.

Title: Notification dots & counts
Steps: 1. Post notification. 2. Toggle `showNotificationCount`; change dot colours.
Expected result: Dot (and count) appear/disappear; clearing notification removes dot.

Title: Always reload icons / package install, update, remove
Steps: 1. Install, update, uninstall an app via adb.
Expected result: Icon appears/updates/disappears in drawer and on home within seconds.

Title: Enable Lawnchair smartspace
Expected result: Date/time rows appear; `smartspaceTimeFormat` honoured.

Title: Providers: battery, torch, now playing, onboarding, calendar
Steps: 1. Charge low battery / turn on torch / play music / have calendar event.
Expected result: Matching card appears and clears.

Title: Smartspacer integration
Expected result: Cards from Smartspacer shown; uninstalling it falls back with no crash.

Title: Google modes unavailable
Expected result: Option not available; no crash.

Title: Smartspace tap actions
Expected result: Calendar / relevant app opens.

Title: Swipe-up-to-home from app
Expected result: Window-to-icon animation; lands on home; no stuck surface.

Title: Overview (recents) open, scroll, dismiss task, clear all
Steps: 1. Open overview. 2. Swipe task away. 3. Clear all.
Expected result: Tasks update; no freeze.

Title: Quick switch (swipe on nav bar)
Expected result: Switches to previous app.

Title: Overview actions (screenshot, select, share) & task shortcuts
Expected result: Actions fire; Lawnchair overlay tweaks visible.

Title: Split screen (incl. Baklava)
Steps: 1. Overview → split-screen on a task. 2. Pick second app.
Expected result: Split session starts (regression #7570)

Title: Taskbar on large screens / `enableTaskbarOnPhone`
Expected result: Taskbar shown/hidden; drag-to-split works.

Title: Quickstep unavailable warning
Expected result: Warning shown (`showQuickstepWarningIfNecessary`); basic launcher still works.

Title: Create backup (layout+settings)
Steps: 1. Settings → Backup → Create. 2. Choose layout & settings. 3. Save.
Expected result: File `Lawnchair_Backup <date>.lawnchairbackup` created; opens as ZIP containing `info.pb`, `launcher.db`, prefs files, `screenshot.png`.

Title: Create backup incl. wallpaper
Expected result: ZIP additionally has `wallpaper.png`.

Title: Restore on same device
Expected result: Launcher restarts; layout/settings equal to backup.

Title: Restore on different device/screen size
Expected result: Layout adapts; no crash; missing apps omitted.

Title: Corrupt / wrong file / newer version
Preconditions: Truncated zip; random file; modified `info.pb` version
Expected result: Clear error; current layout untouched.

Title: Restore Nova backup
Expected result: Converted layout appears (`NovaBackupConverter`); unsupported items skipped.

Title: Zip round-trip unit test
Steps: 1. Write backup to temp stream; read back handlers.
Expected result: Entries identical; version constant checked.

Title: Parse valid file
Expected result: Rules list has expected types and order.

Title: Version rules
Steps: 1. Duplicate `$` version line. 2. Unsupported version (e.g. `$99`). 3. Rule before version line.
Expected result: Cases 1 and 2 throw `FlowerpotFormatException` ("can only appear once" / "Unsupported version"); verify case 3 against `LineParser` and record actual behaviour.

Title: Comments & blank lines ignored
Expected result: No rule produced.

Title: Matching packages / intents
Steps: 1. Match app with package rule, intent-action rule, category rule.
Expected result: Matches only declared apps.

Title: Unknown code rule
Expected result: Behaviour per `CodeRules`/`LineParser`; record actual result and pin it as the expected value.

Title: Open every settings screen
Steps: 1. Navigate through every screen in Preferences dashboard, incl. Experimental, Feature flags, Debug.
Expected result: No crash; back navigation works; screen state retained on rotation.

Title: Defaults on fresh install
Expected result: Equal to documented defaults (snapshot test).

Title: Legacy → DataStore migration
Expected result: Values migrated once; no ANR (regression #7571); idempotent.

Title: Preference change reflected live
Steps: 1. Change setting while launcher visible (split/ multi-window).
Expected result: Home updates without restart where designed; otherwise prompts restart.

Title: Search within settings & about page
Expected result: Opens; links launch browser.

Title: Settings dark/light + dynamic colour
Expected result: UI adapts; no unreadable text.

Title: Reset / feature flags don't persist beyond intended
Expected result: Flag persisted or reset per design.

Title: Runtime permissions requested only when needed
Expected result: Permission requested at use; denial leaves feature disabled, no crash.

Title: Accessibility service required actions
Steps: 1. Trigger gestures needing accessibility w/o service.
Expected result: Prompt to enable; after enabling works (`LawnchairAccessibilityService`).

Title: Root helper availability
Expected result: Rooted: works. Non-rooted: `RootNotAvailableException` handled, user-visible message.

Title: Notification listener access
Expected result: Dots appear only when granted.

Title: Work profile apps & badges
Expected result: Badge icon; paused state; widgets from work profile.

Title: Private space (Android 15+)
Expected result: Apps hidden/shown without crash.

Title: Secondary user / guest
Expected result: Launcher loads per-user data.

Title: Tablet, foldable, multi-display
Expected result: Layouts valid on all form factors.

Title: Locale / RTL / large font / display size
Expected result: No clipped essential text; RTL mirrored.

Title: Monkey / fuzz run
Expected result: No crash/ANR attributable to Lawnchair.

Title: Memory leak smoke
Expected result: Heap stable (LeakCanary / `dumpsys meminfo`).

Title: Scroll jank
Expected result: Janky frames within agreed budget.

Title: Startup with baseline profile
Expected result: No regression vs previous release.

Title: Logcat scan
Expected result: No entries for Lawnchair processes.

Title: Launcher3 multivalent tests
Expected result: All pass or known-failure list maintained.

Expected result: Home/ drawer / widget flows pass.
